gap_statement: Deep-learning MSI detectors keep high sensitivity but lose specificity on external cohorts (pooled 0.86 internal vs 0.71 external), which the authors attribute to overfitting and a lack of algorithm standardisation
source: Li et al. 2025, systematic review and meta-analysis
positioning: Our external CPTAC-COAD drop is the expected behaviour, not an anomaly - say so before someone else does

gap_statement: In a multi-target CRC model, biomarkers with high AUROC largely correlated with MSI, with predictions depending considerably on MSI-associated morphology
source: Gustav et al. 2025, multicentre cohort study
positioning: Any non-MSI target (KRAS, TP53, CDH1) must be shown not to be an MSI proxy - a concrete, cheap analysis to add

gap_statement: All 20 evaluated pathology foundation models show robustness deficits to non-biological (centre) features, and these can cause major diagnostic downstream errors
positioning: Justifies hospital-grouped CV as a design requirement rather than a nicety

gap_statement: Benchmark contamination and data overlap, plus limited generalisation across institutions, are named as core barriers to foundation-model deployment in pathology
source: Zhang et al. 2026, review of FMs in cancer pathology
positioning: Direct citation for the TCGA-pretraining contamination caveat on UNI/Phikon results

gap_statement: Foundation-model training recipes may not generalise without task-specific fine-tuning: UNI led TCGA cross-validation (0.778 balanced accuracy) but fell behind on external PAIP (0.764), while a fine-tuned ResNet34 beat all FMs internally (0.836)
source: Bilal et al. 2025, FM benchmark for MSI
positioning: Pre-empts 'why not just use the biggest encoder' and gives a published comparator for our frozen-encoder choice

gap_statement: A validation crisis persists - poor generalisability in zero-shot testing, black-box explainability and absent regulatory frameworks block FM translation; robust external validation and standardised benchmarking are called essential
source: Cheng & Wong 2025, review of FMs and copilots in cancer pathology
journal: Journal of Experimental and Clinical Cancer Research
positioning: Frames a locked test set plus a genuinely external cohort as the contribution, not the model

gap_statement: Independent multicentre validation with clinically adjudicated MSI-H/dMMR endpoints remains necessary before clinical application, even for well-calibrated TCGA-derived models (pooled ROC-AUC 0.913 internal falling to 0.788 across source splits)
source: Özkan Vardar & Vardar 2026, calibration-aware Phikon framework
positioning: The closest published twin of our pipeline - cite it as the comparator our numbers sit beside

gap_statement: Pathology-image studies have been criticised for not correlating rich proteomic data with histologic features; the first pan-cancer attempt covered six CPTAC cancer types, none of them colorectal
source: Wang et al. 2023, DL integrates histopathology and proteogenomics
positioning: The opening for an image-to-MMR-protein analysis in CPTAC-COAD, stated with its precedent acknowledged
